required_closure: Validate the exact bucket and bind authentication, expected-owner, requester policy, and one atomic active-upload page to it.
Strictly decode one bounded delimiter, group matching suffixes into unique CommonPrefixes, and preserve exact scope across continuation.
Accept only url and encode exactly the modeled key-bearing response positions without encoding upload identifiers.
Preserve one bounded decoded key marker; with UploadIdMarker it forms an indivisible cursor, while alone it excludes the equal key.
Require one canonical integer from 1 through 1000 and bound the combined upload/common-prefix candidates and continuation result.
Strictly decode one bounded prefix, filter exact key bytes before delimiter grouping, and preserve the same scope on every continued request.
Ignore it when KeyMarker is absent; otherwise pair it with KeyMarker and resume same-key uploads according to the pinned marker rule.
Reject duplicate or mismatched owner with the modeled authenticated response before active-upload state is observed.
Accept only requester; enforce configured billing policy or return authenticated explicit unsupported without listing state.
Require one bounded nonempty value equal to the requested bucket after XML decoding.
Require a bounded echoed cursor component consistent with the request; absence and empty represent the default marker under the pinned model.
Require a bounded echoed cursor component consistent with the paired request and ignore semantics when the key marker was absent.
When truncated require one nonempty advancing key component; when terminal permit omission or the modeled empty value only.
Require the echoed decoded or URL-encoded request prefix under the selected encoding policy and preserve allowed empty/default form.
Require the echoed decoded or URL-encoded request delimiter and validate its exact relation to CommonPrefixes grouping.
For a general-purpose truncated page require the paired upload-ID component selected with NextKeyMarker; terminal pages permit omission or empty.
Require one canonical 1-through-1000 value equal to the admitted request maximum and bound combined page candidates to it.
Require one canonical boolean consistent with both next-marker components and the bounded page result.
Bound and validate complete unique upload records ordered by key then initiation time with deterministic tie handling and exact policy metadata.
Bound unique nonempty grouped prefixes, order them with page candidates, exclude grouped uploads, and apply marker/prefix/delimiter scope.
Preserve omission or require url exactly when requested and validate every modeled encoded key-bearing output consistently.
Preserve omission separately and accept only one requester singleton consistent with admitted billing policy.
